title: X @EsemicolonR: Captionless GTA 6 meme-phone clip hits 1M views inside commentary bubble

signal_snapshot.summary: Captionless video post on X by commentary creator E;R (@EsemicolonR) showing a first-person GTA 6-style beach/car driving clip. Metrics: 1M views, 46K likes, 9.3K bookmarks, 4K reposts, 198 replies; hyper-niche X/gaming commentary jokes.

question: Classify the cross-platform spread stage (echo_chamber, emerging_contagion, or mainstream_breakout) and explain the audience overlap and cross-platform dynamics.

ground_truth.label: echo_chamber
ground_truth.rationale: Confirmed echo_chamber: despite 1M views and 46K likes on X, the captionless edit and creator-specific replies remained inside a niche X/gaming commentary bubble.
